1. Demyelinating/inflammatory lesion of the dorsal midbrain (multiple sclerosis)
2. Space-occupying lesion of the midbrain (e.g., tumor or cavernoma) not yet excluded
3. Compressive aneurysm of the posterior communicating artery (despite pupil-sparing on current exam)
